title: A write while one replica is down
request:
W = 3 of N = 3 with everybody up, then with one down, then W = 2 with one up

./your_program.sh quorum
sloppy 3 3 3
sloppy 3 3 2
sloppy 3 2 1
note: All three writes are accepted, which is the whole point of being sloppy, but only the first one is a quorum write. The second and third were completed by a node outside the preference list, so the overlap argument from stage 08 does not cover them and `strict` has to say so.

title: Hinted handoff
request:
`n4` takes two writes belonging to `n1`, then `n1` comes back

./your_program.sh quorum
hint n1 n4 user-42
hint n1 n4 user-99
hints n1
handoff n1
hints n1
note: A hint is per owner, and the handoff is what makes it temporary. A store that delivers the data but keeps the hint hands the same keys over again on the next handoff, and one that drops the hint without delivering has quietly lost a write that was acknowledged.
